product.name: Complaint Management
product.description: A system to screen all customer complaints and escalate serious issues for further review.

product.name: Call Monitoring
product.description: A tool providing live transcription and summarization of calls to detect customer escalations.

product.name: Issue Management
product.description: A platform to track and mitigate critical issues involving multiple stakeholders in lending operations.

product.name: Marketing Review
product.description: A system to create custom scorecards that flag problematic marketing materials for compliance review.

product.name: Reg Compliance Testing
product.description: A service to upload test scripts and automate transaction-level compliance testing for various regulations.

product.name: OFAC Geofencing
product.description: A tool to test whether access to apps and websites is restricted in sanctioned regions.
